Subject: Request: Hosted API concession for Neurolytics — 25% off (12mo)

Hi team,

Quick ask: Neurolytics (NEURO-482) is pushing us for a material concession on Hosted API usage pricing — procurement is asking for a formal exec sign-off to approve a 25% unit-rate concession for the first 12 months. Im escalating because this is >20% and outside our standard pricing bands.

Summary:
- ACV: ~$480k ARR expected year 1 (based on their forecasted token usage).
- Ask: 25% off standard hosted API unit price for 12 months, applied to all usage above a $25k/mo committed minimum.
- Rationale: They are choosing between us and two competitors; legal + procurement said were the preferred tech but price is the blocker. Theyre willing to sign a 12-month committed spend and provide a joint press reference if we win. They also indicated potential expansion to Dedicated next year (estimated +3x).
- Risk: Accepting a concession could set a precedent for neighboring accounts in the same vertical; however, the deal is strategic (healthcare analytics) and has a named exec sponsor (CPO Daniel Park).

Attachments: SOW v3, recent usage report (Q2). Ive added a quick revenue impact snapshot below.

Revenue impact (high level):
- Gross revenue delta: ~ -25% on token margin for first 12 months (~$120k less revenue)
- Net retention upside: high probability of expansion to Dedicated in 12-18 months which offsets the concession.

Recommended approval terms (what Im asking for):
1) Approve 25% concession on Hosted API unit rate for 12 months.
2) Require a $25k/mo minimum committed spend for the 12 months (monthly true-up).
3) Add a clause that rate reverts to list after 12 months or upon early termination.
4) No additional discounts or stacking with partner promos.

Can we get an exec decision by EOD Fri (8/06)? Procurement is scheduling a final signature window. If approved, Ill route to Legal for a short amendment and to Finance for revenue accounting.

Thanks,

Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

- If we grant 25% off for 12 months with a $25k/mo commit, the expected realized revenue for Y1 is ~$360k (vs $480k list) — negative delta ~120k as Ben noted.
